diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS; GCB phenotype by Hans algorithm.
stage: Lugano/Ann Arbor stage I non-bulky disease because disease is limited to one cervical lymph-node region with no extranodal or marrow involvement.
biology: Neither double-expressor nor double-hit lymphoma. MYC 15% and BCL2 30% are below common IHC thresholds, and MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 rearrangements are negative by FISH, so this is not double-hit lymphoma.
prognosis: Use IPI and CNS-IPI. IPI is low risk because age is under 60, LDH is normal, stage is I, ECOG is 0, and there is no extranodal disease. CNS-IPI is low.
first_line_treatment: Curative-intent immunochemotherapy for limited-stage non-bulky DLBCL, such as abbreviated R-CHOP followed by involved-site radiotherapy, PET-adapted therapy, or full-course R-CHOP depending on local standard and patient factors. DA-EPOCH-R is not indicated from the supplied facts.
cns_risk: CNS prophylaxis is mandatory for every DLBCL patient.
response_assessment: Use FDG PET-CT with Lugano/Deauville criteria, especially end-of-treatment PET.
missing_information: cardiac function and viral serologies before rituximab/anthracycline therapy
